result.title: WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model
result.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, including supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA
result.summary: JEPA-based world models predict action consequences in latent space, but representative planning approaches rely on candidate-action search, requiring repeated evaluation of action sequences and incurring substantial online computational cost. Direct action generation avoids this search, yet how to leverage latent predictions to guide action generation given task goals remains a key challenge in translating learned physical dynamics into effective decisions. We introduce WA-JEPA, a world-action model that couples action generation, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-aware feedback. The model first generates an action proposal and predicts the resulting future scenes and proprioceptive states, then refines the proposal through two complementary feedback paths, using the task goal as a reference. Goal-discrepancy residual feedback (GDRF) uses differences between the latent representations of predicted scenes and the task goal to guide chunk-wise action refinement. Future-scene context feedback (FSCF) preserves fine-grained predicted scene representations to guide subsequent action refinement. Jointly learned from offline demonstrations, this process iteratively updates the same plan before execution, making future predictions directly participate in action generation without candidate-action search. We evaluate short-horizon goal reaching, long-horizon tasks, and full-task execution. The results show that goal-aware predictive feedback supports competitive task performance while maintaining a compact model and low online computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 WA-JEPA 世界-动作模型：直接生成动作提案并预测未来场景与本体检知 latent，再用「目标与预测场景 latent 的差异」以及保留的细粒度未来场景上下文两条反馈路径分块迭代修正动作，执行前反复更新同一计划，从而避免候选动作搜索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以目标 latent 差异驱动迭代修正、并跨轮保留预测上下文」的机制可能为 LVR 的 latent 假设更新、视觉证据筛选与何时停止提供概念参照，但属机器人世界模型，迁移可行性有待核查。
